about: Sokki's sample meeting: an invented two-minute call between three invented people (Maya, Daniel, Priya). Not a real meeting, no real names. Spoken by Kokoro-82M voices (Apache-2.0); built by testdata/sample_meeting/build.py into src-tauri/resources/sample-meeting/call.flac.
lines: Okay, I think we're all here. Thanks for joining, both of you. This is our last check-in before the checkout launch, so let's keep it short.
Sounds good, Maya. Quick update from my side: the new checkout works on every phone we tested, except one thing. Apple Pay still fails on older iPhones.
How long would it take to fix that?
Honestly, at least a week. Apple has to review the change, and that's out of our hands.
Then I'd launch without Apple Pay. Card payments work fine, and we can add Apple Pay in the next release.
I agree. Daniel, are you okay with that?
Yes, that works for me. I'll hide the Apple Pay button for now.
Great. So we ship on Thursday, with cards only. Priya, how is the design side looking?
Almost done. The only screen left is the empty cart. Right now it just says zero items, which feels a bit cold. I'll add a short line and a button back to the shop.
Can you have that ready by Wednesday, so Daniel can still build it in?
One more thing. The delivery address field still drops the apartment number when you paste an address. I'll fix that tomorrow.
Good catch. Customers would hate that. Okay, then on my side, I'll write to our twenty beta testers on Friday and ask how the new checkout feels.
Could you ask them about the empty cart too? I'd love to know if the new line helps.
Sure, I'll add that question. Anything else before we wrap up?

Perfect. So: launch on Thursday without Apple Pay. Daniel fixes the address field tomorrow and hides the button. Priya finishes the empty cart by Wednesday morning. And I email the beta testers on Friday. Thanks, everyone!
